assets.name: Purple rice
aliases: ข้าวไรซ์เบอร์รี่
assets.description: A bowl of dark brown-red rice grains with a few pale kernels, loose mound above the rim.

assets.name: Rice porridge
assets.description: A bowl of loose white rice soup with a spoon, ginger threads and a soft-egg mark, watery cream wash.

assets.name: Steamed bun
assets.description: Two plump white steamed buns, one split to show a dark filling, soft cream wash and pleat ink.

assets.name: Sushi
assets.description: Two nigiri and three maki pieces on a slate, rice grain marks, a red-orange fish wash and nori band.

assets.name: Tofu
aliases: เต้าหู้ทอด
ฟองเต้าหู้
assets.description: Golden fried tofu cubes and one pale soft block, dry-brush crust over cream interior.

assets.name: Minced pork
assets.description: A crumbly heap of browned minced pork with oil sheen dots, ochre-brown broken wash.

assets.name: Larb
assets.description: A plate of minced meat salad with mint leaves, toasted rice and chili flake marks, herb-green over brown.

assets.name: Boiled pork slices
assets.description: Pale sliced boiled pork belly fanned on a plate, layered cream-pink wash with a thin fat line.

assets.name: Poached chicken
assets.description: Pale poached chicken sliced and partly shredded, soft cream wash and minimal ink.

assets.name: Sardines
aliases: ปลาซาร์ดีน
ปลากระป๋อง
assets.description: An open rectangular tin with three sardines in oil, muted warm-grey fish wash and a rolled lid.

assets.name: Cold cuts
assets.description: Overlapping thin rounds of pink cured meat with fat flecks, one slice folded, on a board.

assets.name: Dumplings
assets.description: Four pleated dumplings, two pan-browned and two pale steamed, on a small plate with a dip cup.

assets.name: Meatballs
aliases: ลูกชิ้นปิ้ง
assets.description: Five round meatballs, three on a bamboo skewer with char marks, cream-brown wash.

assets.name: Iced coffee
aliases: อเมริกาโน่เย็น
assets.description: A tall clear cup of dark coffee over ice with a straw, cubes as pale negative shapes.

assets.name: Matcha latte
aliases: มัทฉะลาเต้
assets.description: A glass of pale green matcha over milk with a swirl line, sage/leaf wash and a straw.

assets.name: Soy milk
aliases: น้ำเต้าหู้
assets.description: A stout bottle and a small glass of off-white soy milk with a few dark sesame specks.

assets.name: Milk tea
aliases: ชานมไข่มุก
assets.description: A tall cup of orange-cream tea with ice and a wide straw, dark pearls settled at the base.

assets.name: Som tum
assets.description: A mound of shredded pale-green papaya with tomato wedges, long bean and chili marks in a shallow dish.

assets.name: Eggplant
assets.description: Sautéed eggplant rounds with glossy brown-red skin and pale soft flesh, oil sheen marks.

assets.name: Green salad
assets.description: A bowl of loose mixed leaves with a beet slice and almond slivers, leaf/sage overlapping washes.

assets.name: Chili oil
aliases: พริกน้ำมัน
assets.description: A small jar of red-orange oil with sunk chili flake sediment and a drizzle spoon.

assets.name: Gravy
assets.description: A small sauce boat with dark gravy pouring a short arc, brown wash and a spoon rest.

assets.name: Thai sweets
assets.description: Three small ceramic cups of layered coconut custard and one chewy dark taro piece, cream/peach wash.

assets.name: Curry
assets.description: A bowl of red-orange coconut curry with meat pieces and basil leaf marks, oil sheen ring at the rim.
